### Don't Panic, Keep Calm
Author: One Year Devotions for Men
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/don-t-panic-keep-calm-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-7.html
Passage: Isaiah 7:9
Points:
- Ahaz and the people of Jerusalem trembled in terror when threatened by allied invaders.
- God sent the prophet Isaiah to assure Ahaz that the enemy kings were merely spent embers.
- Ahaz faced a pivotal choice between relying on a political treaty or trusting God's intervention.
- When facing difficult dilemmas, believers must seek what the Lord has said and obey Him.
- Trusting the Lord to protect and act on our behalf always proves reliable in the end.

### Girlfriends in God - July 26, 2010
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-july-26-2010-11635157.html
Passage: Isaiah 7:9
Points:
- Spiritual endurance requires strong, living faith rather than reliance on human standards of success.
- Genuine faith means resting in God's character with the simple confidence of a trusting child.
- Doubt and fragile faith often blind believers to the reality of God's power despite past miracles.
- God allows storms and demanding circumstances into our lives to build and deepen our trust in Him.
